displayPattern: Display on an LG front-load washer or washer-dryer combo: PS (can look like P5 on a 7-segment display)
meaning: Power supply issue: LG says PS means the washer has a power supply problem and stops because it cannot continue the program. It can read as P5, because S and 5 look the same on the display.
causes: The washer is plugged into a power strip instead of a wall outlet
A problem with the power reaching the washer
diySteps: Do not use a power strip. Plug the power cord directly into a wall outlet
Unplug the washer, wait 60 seconds, then plug it back in and restart it
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: LG says that if PS persists after the cord is plugged directly into a wall outlet and the washer has been restarted, request service. PS is not PF, which is a power failure during a cycle, such as an outage.
sourceTitle: LG Front Load Washer – Error Code List (LG USA Support)
